title: PAR-134 CMC Foreground-to-ACI-7 scalar projection
mode: official API contract review plus generated AC1024 fast implementation slice
scope: Map CMC method C5 Foreground to the existing scalar ACI foreground value 7
Retain C5 as the decoded method for consumers that request the method side channel
Verify the C5 projection independently from C3 indexed ACI 7 and retain following-field alignment

autodeskColorMethod.finding: The documented AcCmEntityColor::ColorMethod enum assigns kForeground method byte 0xC5 and distinguishes it from kByACI at 0xC3.

autodeskForegroundPredicate.finding: The AcCmColor isForeground contract returns true for kForeground or for kByACI with kACIForeground. This supports their foreground projection equivalence.
autodeskForegroundPredicate.limit: API semantic evidence does not establish the C5 packed low-24-bit payload or optional-name encoding used by a DWG producer.

odaDwgSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaDwgSpecification.finding: R2004+ CMC uses a reserved BS index, method-packed BL, and RC flags for optional TV color/book names.
odaDwgSpecification.limit: This generic field definition does not provide producer-specific C5 payload semantics.

localSource.finding: getCmColor already exposes an optional method out-parameter; the scalar return can project Foreground to 7 without rewriting the captured method byte. The specialized HATCH-gradient reader is separate.

generatedControls.finding: Generated AC1024 C3/ACI-7 and C5/Foreground CMC fields project to scalar 7 while preserving distinct method bytes, non-RGB state, reserved index, RC flags, and a following 3-bit sentinel.
generatedControls.limit: The C5 packed low byte is test data only; this does not qualify real producer output or HATCH-gradient C5 handling.

changes.productionSummary: dwgBuffer::getCmColor returns scalar 7 for C5 Foreground while retaining the parsed method through outMethod and leaving RGB absent.
generatedTests: Added a focused CMC foreground projection selector to tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp.
Compared C5 Foreground with C3 indexed ACI 7 while asserting that their raw method values remain distinct and the next field stays aligned.

commands.command: git diff --check -- src/intern/dwgbuffer.cpp src/drw_objects.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp CMakeLists.txt

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: C5 no longer collapses to the generic ByLayer-shaped scalar fallback in getCmColor; method-aware callers still observe C5 and the public scalar representation becomes ACI foreground 7.
unresolved: Real DWG producer payload and optional-name behavior for C5 remain unverified.
The specialized HATCH-gradient C5 parse/write route remains gated on producer evidence.
Shared CMC consumers that cannot retain method metadata need class-specific audit; C4 and C6-C8 remain internal-only/unsupported for third-party projection.
External/native CAD qualification and independent semantic evidence remain separate gates.
assessment.nextAction: Continue a class-by-class CMC caller audit, adding local consumer tests where a scalar projection currently loses a documented method; retain HATCH-gradient producer gating and external qualification.
